newsitem.title: UK: CORTECS TO HOLD ANALYSTS CONFERENCE CALL.
newsitem.headline: CORTECS TO HOLD ANALYSTS CONFERENCE CALL.

text.p: Cortecs International Ltd will hold an analyst conference call on Wednesday, the Anglo-Australian pharmaceutical firm said on Tuesday.
The company is conducting trials on the orally administered drugs Macrotonin, designed to counter the bone wasting disease osteoporosis, and Pseudostat which combats bronchitis.
"The purpose of the call is to explain what has happened over last few days, first with Macrotonin then Pseudostat," said Cortecs president, Michael Flynn.
The conference call is scheduled to start at 1500 GMT.
The company's stock rose earlier in the day after it announced positive preliminary results in its Pseudostat trials.
By 1220 GMT the shares were trading up 24 pence at 2.40 stg. It spiked at 2.50 stg during the morning session, levels not seen since May 14.
Analysts were mixed on the Pseudostat announcement with several saying they would not make their mind up about the drug until more detailed results come out in a couple of weeks.
Some said it was a good sign the company was making progress towards its goal to produce an orally delivered peptide and protein biotechnology drugs, normally administered by injection.
Cortecs is working towards a platform technology which could be applied to many different drugs, usually injected, such as insulin for diabetics.
Flynn said no new scientific information would be released at the meeting. --Nicholas Winning, London newsroom +44 171 542 4367
